_one_line: The PROFILE is what the TENANT IS. The capability model is what WE KNOW about it. Two different questions about the same system — and the delta between them is the work.

_why_a_new_concept.trigger: s097 — an external Business Process Review asked 'which modules are implemented and which are actively used'. The brain could not answer it. It held the HOW (operating model: 80.6% external orchestration; 37 integration flows) and it held OUR KNOWLEDGE (capability_model: domain x 11 capabilities), but nowhere did it hold the WHAT: the tenant's own footprint. The answer had to be re-derived live from cvers + audit logs and was wrong on 6 modules (RE-FX, SD, FI-AA, PM, TRM, PBC) plus an entire missing category (third-party add-ons).
_why_a_new_concept.diagnosis: Those 6 were not unknown — they were UNADDRESSED. PBC was in the brain as an 'engine' inside a prose doc; RE-FX had a domain folder; the add-ons had a companion. Knowledge existed but was not KEYED on the question being asked. A store you cannot query by the question you are asked is not knowledge, it is storage.
_why_a_new_concept.principle: CP-001 traceability + CP-003 evidence. A concept earns its place when a whole CLASS of question has no home. 'What is this tenant?' is that class.

_definition.profile: The measured reality of ONE tenant/system landscape: what is installed, what is configured, what is productive, how it is operated, who uses it, and through which channels data enters and leaves.
_definition.keyed_on: SAP APPLICATION COMPONENT (the technical module: FI-AA-AA, PA-PM-PB, RE-FX-CN...). This is deliberately a DIFFERENT axis from the capability model's canonical domain key.
not_the_profile: our coverage/knowledge of a domain -> that is capability_model (L15)
object-level graph -> that is L1 objects
an opinion, a roadmap or a recommendation -> the profile carries FACTS with evidence only

_evidence_tiers._rule: Every module MUST carry one of these. Never state a module without its tier — 'implemented' alone is the ambiguity that caused the s097 failure.
_evidence_tiers.INSTALLED: component present in CVERS. Near-meaningless on its own: 177 components are installed and most ship by default.
_evidence_tiers.CONFIGURED: organisational structure / customising exists (company code, sales org, plant, asset company code...).
_evidence_tiers.PRODUCTIVE: business documents exist AND/OR transactions are executed in the audit log.
_evidence_tiers.NOT_USED: the module exists but zero documents and zero executions — an ASSERTED negative, only valid when actually probed.
_evidence_tiers.NOT_EVIDENCED: we have no evidence either way. NOT the same as NOT_USED. Never collapse the two.
_evidence_tiers._adoption_is_a_separate_axis: Do NOT widen this vocabulary to express extent. The TIER answers 'how do we know?'; the optional `adoption` field (FULL/PARTIAL/MARGINAL) answers 'how far is it rolled out?'. Collapsing the two is what produced statuses like 'PARTIAL' that mean neither. Caught by the I1 gate on its first run — the gate paid for itself immediately.

_strata.note: The profile has three strata, in increasing order of what they cost to establish and of what they are worth.
_strata.1_footprint: installed / configured / productive per module + org structure. Cheap, factual, and the thing external parties always ask for first.
_strata.2_operation: HOW it is run: channel mix (dialog vs RFC vs IDoc vs batch vs file), who orchestrates, read vs write direction. This is where UNESCO's 80.6%-external headline lives.
_strata.3_periphery: what surrounds the core: third-party add-ons, the digital front-end (OData/Fiori), users and licences, and every channel through which data EXITS. Systematically forgotten, and the richest for a governance conversation.

_interrelations._design: The profile is not a leaf. It is the SPINE that the other stores hang off. Each link below is a LOOKUP (explicit key), never a fuzzy token match — the mistake ontology.json already had to correct once.
_interrelations.profile.module -> ontology.canonical_key: explicit `capability_domain` field per module. Resolves the technical module onto the canonical domain vocabulary.
_interrelations.profile.module -> capability_model.domai: via the above. Answers: for a module that is PRODUCTIVE, do we actually have capability coverage? A PRODUCTIVE module with no capability row is a SYSTEM-LEVEL BLIND SPOT — a different and more serious animal than the object-level blind_spots (L12), which are names we mentioned without a node.
_interrelations.profile.module -> claims: by domain + by related_objects. Every profile assertion must be traceable to a claim with evidence.
_interrelations.profile.module -> knowledge/domains/<x>/: the prose layer (artifact hierarchy: brain .md -> companion .html -> Word).
_interrelations.profile.operating_model -> knowledge/sys: the profile SUMMARISES; those docs stay the source of truth for per-flow detail. Never duplicate them here.
_interrelations.profile.third_party_addons -> F_INTERFAC: each add-on is an independent data-exit channel and therefore a governance object, not a licence line item.
_interrelations.profile -> capability_model: COMPLEMENTARY, NOT NESTED. Profile = the system. Capability model = our knowledge of it. Do not merge them; the delta between the two IS the backlog.

_module_to_domain._authority: EXPLICIT mapping, hand-maintained. `null` = no canonical domain exists yet -> that is a finding, not an error. s097: PBC/FI_AA/PM/SD/TRM/CO mapped to new same-named capability rows after the crossing exposed them as system-level blind spots.

_invariants.I1: Every module carries an evidence tier AND its evidence string. No tier without evidence.
_invariants.I2: NOT_USED requires an actual probe. Absence in the Gold DB or in executed_objects_domain_map is a FLOOR, never an inventory — it yields NOT_EVIDENCED, never NOT_USED.
_invariants.I3: Technical component names are resolved from the system (TADIR -> TDEVC -> DF14L), never from memory.
_invariants.I4: The profile is rendered into BRAIN_INDEX.md at bootstrap. If a session has to re-derive the footprint, the profile has failed — fix the profile, do not answer from scratch.
_invariants.I5: The profile is TENANT-SCOPED. Nothing here is portable to another client; the CONCEPT and the build scripts are.

_maintenance.who_updates: any session that measures something about the system's footprint, operation or periphery — before it answers, not after.
_maintenance.how: edit unesco_system_profile.json, then `python brain_v2/system_profile/build_profile_links.py` (also runs inside rebuild_all.py), which recomputes the interrelations and the gap report.
_maintenance.gate: build_profile_links.py FAILS LOUD on an invariant breach (module without tier, NOT_USED without evidence, unmapped module key).
